---
title: "Fig.1 Panel C — differential expression between conditions (unfiltered transcripts)"
output: html_document
---

Pseudobulk differential expression between YPD, fluconazole and synthetic
complete 2% glucose (sc2glu), using the pseudobulk matrices **before** the
"reliable transcripts" filter (`pseudobulk_<dataset>_without_filtering_transcripts.txt`).
The filtered matrices drop key fluconazole-response genes (ERG11, ERG3, UPC2, ...),
so the DE here is run on all genes, with a light expression filter per comparison.

Five datasets: YPD.1, YPD.2, Flu.1, Flu.2 and sc2glu.2.

- YPD.1 and YPD.2 are true replicates.
- Flu.1 (16 ug/ml fluconazole) and Flu.2 (8 ug/ml) are **not** replicates: they
  are two doses, each a single 10x run, so dose and batch are confounded between them.
- sc2glu.1 is a true replicate of sc2glu.2 but is left out of the DE: it is small
  (~1,700 cells after doublet removal) and, in DE against it, lowly expressed
  genes are systematically inflated (median log2FC ~ +0.9 vs ~ +0.1 against
  sc2glu.2), which produces many artefactual "up in sc2glu.1" genes. sc2glu.1 is
  used only for the PCA and reproducibility checks in
  `Fig1-PanelC-does-gene-experession-differ-bwn-condition.Rmd`.

Comparisons:

- 8 cross-condition comparisons: YPD vs Flu (each YPD replicate against each
  Flu dose, 4), YPD vs sc2glu.2 (2) and Flu vs sc2glu.2 (one per dose, 2).
- 1 replicate control: YPD.1 vs YPD.2. Each dataset is its own 10x run, so this
  shows how many DE genes batch alone produces; a real condition effect should
  give many more.
- 1 dose comparison: Flu.2 vs Flu.1 (log2FC = 16 / 8 ug/ml). Its DE genes are a
  mix of dose effect and batch effect, which this design cannot separate.

Galactose (scgal.1, synthetic complete with galactose; a single run with no
replicate and 55 strains) is added in a separate section at the end
("Galactose"): YPD vs Galactose (2), Fluconazole vs Galactose (one per dose, 2)
and sc2glu.2 vs Galactose (1). These comparisons use the strains shared by all
six datasets including scgal.1, so the comparisons above keep their original
strain set and results; the galactose section has its own figures.

Genes that are DE in the same direction in every comparison of a condition pair
(4 for YPD vs Flu, 2 for the sc2glu.2 pairs) are reported as the consensus
condition genes. For the Flu pairs this means "responds at both doses", not
"reproducible across replicates"; genes that respond at only one dose are
reported separately.

Method: DESeq2 on pseudobulk counts with a paired design `~ strain + condition`
(the same strain is measured in both datasets, so each strain is its own control).
log2FC = log2(test / ref), where "ref vs test" is the comparison name.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(BiocParallel)
library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Sc.sgd.db)

select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter  # often masked too
first  <- dplyr::first   # masked by S4Vectors
count  <- dplyr::count   # masked by matrixStats
```

# Configuration

```{r config}
BASE <- "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/common_analysis_for_all"

PATHS <- list(
  YPD.1    = file.path(BASE, "YPD.1/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/pseudobulk_YPD.1_all_strains_no_cell_filter.txt"),
  YPD.2    = file.path(BASE, "YPD.2/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/pseudobulk_YPD.2_all_strains_no_cell_filter.txt"),
  Flu.1    = file.path(BASE, "Flu.1/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/pseudobulk_flu.1_all_strains_no_cell_filter.txt"),
  Flu.2    = file.path(BASE, "Flu.2/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/pseudobulk_flu.2_all_strains_no_cell_filter.txt"),
  sc2glu.2 = file.path(BASE, "sc2glu.2/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/pseudobulk_sc2glu.2_only_without_filtering_transcripts.txt"),
  scgal.1  = file.path(BASE, "scgal.1/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/pseudobulk_scgal.1_all_strains_no_cell_filter.txt")
)

# Datasets of the original comparisons; scgal.1 is only used in the Galactose section
BASE_DATASETS <- c("YPD.1", "YPD.2", "Flu.1", "Flu.2", "sc2glu.2")

ANNOT <- "/scratch/aa9679/SingleCell_cerevisiae/Gene_exp_analysis/yeast_custom_annotations.csv"

dataset_condition <- c(YPD.1 = "YPD", YPD.2 = "YPD",
                       Flu.1 = "Fluconazole", Flu.2 = "Fluconazole",
                       sc2glu.2 = "sc2glu", scgal.1 = "Galactose")

# Flu.1 and Flu.2 are different doses, not replicates
flu_dose <- c(Flu.1 = "16 ug/ml", Flu.2 = "8 ug/ml")

# "all_shared": the same strains (present in all 5 datasets) in every comparison,
#               so DE gene counts are comparable across comparisons.
#               Galactose comparisons use the strains present in all 6 datasets
#               (the 5 + scgal.1).
# "per_pair":   all strains shared by the two datasets of each comparison (more power).
STRAIN_MODE <- "all_shared"

# expression filter applied per comparison: keep genes with >= MIN_COUNT counts
# in >= MIN_FRAC of the samples in that comparison
MIN_COUNT <- 10
MIN_FRAC  <- 0.25

PADJ_CUT <- 0.05
LFC_CUT  <- 1

N_CORES <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK", "4"))

OUT_DIR <- "../results/DE_unfiltered"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Load

```{r load}
read_pseudobulk <- function(path, sep = "\t") {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("File not found: ", path, "\n  (getwd(): ", getwd(), ")")
  }
  read.csv(path, sep = sep, row.names = 1, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
}

raw <- lapply(PATHS, read_pseudobulk)

for (nm in names(raw)) {
  cat(sprintf("%-9s %5d genes x %4d strains\n", nm, nrow(raw[[nm]]), ncol(raw[[nm]])))
}
```

All matrices mix ORF IDs and common gene names; convert everything to ORF IDs
so genes match across datasets (same conversion as the Panel C/D Rmd).

```{r orf_conversion}
all_custom_gene_annotations <- read.csv(ANNOT, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

common_to_orf <- all_custom_gene_annotations %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_name), !is.na(gene_id)) %>%
  distinct(gene_name, gene_id) %>%
  deframe()

to_orf <- function(mat, label) {
  ids    <- rownames(mat)
  is_orf <- grepl("^Y[A-Z]{2}\\d{3}[WC](-[A-Z])?$", ids)
  orf    <- ifelse(is_orf, ids,
                   ifelse(ids %in% names(common_to_orf), common_to_orf[ids], ids))
  dup <- duplicated(orf)
  cat(sprintf("%-9s converted %4d names to ORFs | %3d IDs left unconverted | dropped %d duplicates\n",
              label, sum(!is_orf & orf != ids), sum(!grepl("^Y[A-Z]{2}\\d{3}[WC]", orf)), sum(dup)))
  mat <- mat[!dup, , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(mat) <- orf[!dup]
  mat
}

raw <- imap(raw, to_orf)
stopifnot(all(map_lgl(raw, ~ !any(duplicated(rownames(.x))))))
```

# Shared strains

```{r shared}
all_shared_strains     <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(raw[BASE_DATASETS], colnames))
all_shared_strains_gal <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(raw, colnames))
cat("Strains shared across the 5 original datasets:", length(all_shared_strains), "\n")
cat("Strains shared across all 6 datasets (with galactose):", length(all_shared_strains_gal), "\n")
cat("Strain mode:", STRAIN_MODE, "\n")

strains_for <- function(ref, test) {
  if (STRAIN_MODE != "all_shared") return(intersect(colnames(raw[[ref]]), colnames(raw[[test]])))
  if ("scgal.1" %in% c(ref, test)) all_shared_strains_gal else all_shared_strains
}
```

# Ergosterol gene set

Genes annotated to GO:0006696 "ergosterol biosynthetic process" (including child
terms) in SGD.

```{r ergosterol_set}
erg_set <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Sc.sgd.db, keys = "GO:0006696", keytype = "GOALL",
                                 columns = c("ORF", "GENENAME")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ORF)) %>%
  distinct(orf = ORF, gene_name = GENENAME) %>%
  mutate(gene_name = coalesce(gene_name, orf)) %>%
  arrange(gene_name)
erg_orfs <- erg_set$orf

genes_in_all <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(raw[BASE_DATASETS], rownames))
cat("Ergosterol genes (GO:0006696):", nrow(erg_set),
    "| present in all 5 datasets:", sum(erg_orfs %in% genes_in_all), "\n")
cat("Missing:", paste(erg_set$gene_name[!erg_orfs %in% genes_in_all], collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ORF -> common name for labelling
gene_label <- function(orfs) {
  nm <- suppressMessages(AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Sc.sgd.db, keys = orfs, keytype = "ORF",
                                                column = "GENENAME", multiVals = "first"))
  coalesce(unname(nm), orfs)
}
```

# Differential expression

```{r de_fn}
# Add comparison name, conditions, Flu doses, type and condition pair to a
# table of ref / test datasets
annotate_comparisons <- function(cmp) {
  cmp %>%
    mutate(comparison     = paste(ref, "vs", test),
           ref_condition  = dataset_condition[ref],
           test_condition = dataset_condition[test],
           flu_doses      = map2_chr(ref, test, ~ paste(na.omit(flu_dose[c(.x, .y)]), collapse = " vs ")),
           type = case_when(ref_condition != test_condition ~ "cross-condition",
                            ref_condition == "Fluconazole"  ~ "dose comparison",
                            TRUE                            ~ "replicate control"),
           condition_pair = case_when(type == "cross-condition"   ~ paste(ref_condition, "vs", test_condition),
                                      type == "dose comparison"   ~ "Flu dose (16 vs 8 ug/ml)",
                                      TRUE                        ~ "Replicate control"))
}

de_comparisons <- bind_rows(
  crossing(ref = c("YPD.1", "YPD.2"), test = c("Flu.1", "Flu.2")),
  crossing(ref = c("YPD.1", "YPD.2"), test = "sc2glu.2"),
  crossing(ref = c("Flu.1", "Flu.2"), test = "sc2glu.2"),
  tibble(ref = "YPD.1", test = "YPD.2"),
  tibble(ref = "Flu.2", test = "Flu.1")   # log2FC = 16 / 8 ug/ml
) %>%
  annotate_comparisons()

knitr::kable(de_comparisons %>% select(comparison, flu_doses, condition_pair, type))

run_de <- function(ref, test) {
  label   <- paste(ref, "vs", test)
  strains <- strains_for(ref, test)
  genes   <- intersect(rownames(raw[[ref]]), rownames(raw[[test]]))

  counts <- round(cbind(as.matrix(raw[[ref]][genes, strains]),
                        as.matrix(raw[[test]][genes, strains])))
  colnames(counts) <- paste(rep(strains, 2), rep(c(ref, test), each = length(strains)), sep = "|")
  keep   <- rowSums(counts >= MIN_COUNT) >= MIN_FRAC * ncol(counts)
  counts <- counts[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  col_data <- data.frame(
    row.names = colnames(counts),
    strain    = factor(rep(strains, 2)),
    condition = factor(rep(c(ref, test), each = length(strains)), levels = c(ref, test))
  )

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(counts, col_data, design = ~ strain + condition)
  dds <- tryCatch(
    estimateSizeFactors(dds),
    error = function(e) {
      message(label, ": standard size factors failed, using type = 'poscounts'")
      estimateSizeFactors(dds, type = "poscounts")
    }
  )
  dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE, parallel = N_CORES > 1,
               BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(N_CORES))

  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", test, ref), alpha = PADJ_CUT)

  out <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    mutate(comparison = label,
           n_strains  = length(strains),
           direction  = case_when(
             padj < PADJ_CUT & log2FoldChange >  LFC_CUT ~ paste("up in", test),
             padj < PADJ_CUT & log2FoldChange < -LFC_CUT ~ paste("up in", ref),
             TRUE ~ "not DE"))

  cat(sprintf("%-22s %3d strains | %4d genes | up in %-9s %4d | up in %-9s %4d\n",
              label, length(strains), nrow(counts),
              test, sum(out$direction == paste("up in", test)),
              ref,  sum(out$direction == paste("up in", ref))))
  out
}
```

```{r run_de}
de_res <- map2(de_comparisons$ref, de_comparisons$test, run_de)
names(de_res) <- de_comparisons$comparison

de_all <- bind_rows(de_res) %>%
  left_join(de_comparisons %>% select(comparison, condition_pair, type), by = "comparison") %>%
  mutate(comparison = factor(comparison, levels = de_comparisons$comparison))

gene_names <- setNames(gene_label(unique(de_all$gene)), unique(de_all$gene))
de_all <- de_all %>% mutate(gene_name = gene_names[gene], .after = gene)

de_summary <- de_all %>%
  group_by(comparison, condition_pair, type) %>%
  summarise(n_strains      = first(n_strains),
            n_genes_tested = sum(!is.na(padj)),
            n_up_in_test   = sum(padj < PADJ_CUT & log2FoldChange >  LFC_CUT, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_up_in_ref    = sum(padj < PADJ_CUT & log2FoldChange < -LFC_CUT, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_DE_total     = n_up_in_test + n_up_in_ref,
            .groups = "drop")
knitr::kable(de_summary,
             caption = "DE genes per comparison (padj < 0.05, |log2FC| > 1); log2FC = test / ref")

for (nm in names(de_res)) {
  write.csv(de_all %>% filter(comparison == nm) %>% arrange(padj),
            file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0("DE_", gsub(" ", "_", nm), ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}
write.csv(de_summary, file.path(OUT_DIR, "DE_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Condition effect vs batch baseline

YPD.1 vs YPD.2 is the only true replicate control, so it is the batch baseline.
Flu.2 vs Flu.1 is shown separately: it measures dose and batch together.

```{r de_counts_plot, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5}
p_de_counts <- de_summary %>%
  mutate(comparison = fct_reorder(comparison, n_DE_total)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(n_DE_total, comparison, fill = condition_pair)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("YPD vs Fluconazole"    = "#E15759",
                               "YPD vs sc2glu"         = "#59A14F",
                               "Fluconazole vs sc2glu" = "#F28E2B",
                               "Flu dose (16 vs 8 ug/ml)" = "#B07AA1",
                               "Replicate control"     = "grey60")) +
  labs(x = "DE genes (padj < 0.05, |log2FC| > 1)", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)
p_de_counts

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "DE_counts_vs_replicate_controls.pdf"), p_de_counts,
       width = 9, height = 5, units = "in")
```

## Volcano plots

```{r de_volcano, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 10}
volcano_df <- de_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(
    padj < PADJ_CUT & log2FoldChange >  LFC_CUT ~ "up in test",
    padj < PADJ_CUT & log2FoldChange < -LFC_CUT ~ "up in ref",
    TRUE ~ "not DE"),
    neg_log10_padj = pmin(-log10(padj), 50))   # cap so a few genes don't squash the y-axis

p_volcano <- ggplot(volcano_df, aes(log2FoldChange, neg_log10_padj, color = sig)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5, shape = 16) +
  geom_point(data = ~ filter(.x, gene %in% erg_orfs), color = "black", size = 0.9, shape = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-LFC_CUT, LFC_CUT), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(PADJ_CUT), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("up in test" = "#D6604D", "up in ref" = "#2166AC", "not DE" = "grey75")) +
  facet_wrap(~ comparison, ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = "log2 fold change (test / ref)", y = "-log10 padj (capped at 50)", color = NULL,
       caption = "Black circles: ergosterol genes (GO:0006696)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom")
p_volcano

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "DE_volcano_all_comparisons.pdf"), p_volcano,
       width = 16, height = 10, units = "in")
```

## Do the comparisons agree?

Spearman correlation of log2FC across genes between comparisons. Comparisons
that share a dataset correlate partly because they share that dataset's noise;
the cleanest checks are pairs with no dataset in common (e.g. YPD.1 vs Flu.1 and
YPD.2 vs Flu.2). For YPD vs Flu, such pairs also differ in Flu dose (16 vs 8 ug/ml),
so their agreement reflects the response shared by both doses.

```{r de_agreement, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 9}
lfc_mat <- de_all %>%
  select(gene, comparison, log2FoldChange) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = comparison, values_from = log2FoldChange) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

lfc_cor <- cor(lfc_mat, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")

p_lfc_cor <- as.data.frame(lfc_cor) %>%
  rownames_to_column("a") %>%
  pivot_longer(-a, names_to = "b", values_to = "rho") %>%
  mutate(a = factor(a, levels = de_comparisons$comparison),
         b = factor(b, levels = rev(de_comparisons$comparison))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(a, b, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", rho)), size = 2.6) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Spearman\nrho (log2FC)") +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank())
p_lfc_cor

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "DE_log2FC_correlation.pdf"), p_lfc_cor,
       width = 10, height = 9, units = "in")
```

## Consensus genes per condition pair

A gene is a consensus DE gene for a condition pair if it passes the DE cutoff
in the same direction in every comparison of that pair: for YPD vs Fluconazole,
both YPD replicates against both Flu doses (4); for YPD vs sc2glu, both YPD
replicates against sc2glu.2 (2); for Fluconazole vs sc2glu, both Flu doses
against sc2glu.2 (2). For the Fluconazole pairs a consensus gene responds at
both 8 and 16 ug/ml; dose-specific genes are in the next section.

```{r consensus}
n_cmp_per_pair <- de_comparisons %>%
  filter(type == "cross-condition") %>%
  count(condition_pair, name = "n_expected")

consensus <- de_all %>%
  filter(type == "cross-condition") %>%
  group_by(condition_pair, gene, gene_name) %>%
  summarise(n_comparisons = n(),
            n_up   = sum(padj < PADJ_CUT & log2FoldChange >  LFC_CUT, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_down = sum(padj < PADJ_CUT & log2FoldChange < -LFC_CUT, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_log2FC = mean(log2FoldChange),
            min_abs_log2FC = min(abs(log2FoldChange)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(n_cmp_per_pair, by = "condition_pair") %>%
  filter(n_comparisons == n_expected, n_up == n_expected | n_down == n_expected) %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(n_up == n_expected,
                            paste("up in", str_remove(condition_pair, "^.* vs ")),
                            paste("up in", str_remove(condition_pair, " vs .*$")))) %>%
  arrange(condition_pair, desc(abs(mean_log2FC)))

knitr::kable(consensus %>% count(condition_pair, direction),
             caption = "Consensus DE genes (same direction in every comparison of the pair)")

for (cp in unique(consensus$condition_pair)) {
  print(knitr::kable(consensus %>% filter(condition_pair == cp) %>% head(20) %>%
                       select(gene, gene_name, direction, mean_log2FC, min_abs_log2FC),
                     digits = 2, caption = paste("Top consensus genes:", cp)))
}

write.csv(consensus, file.path(OUT_DIR, "DE_consensus_genes_per_condition_pair.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Dose-specific genes (YPD vs Fluconazole)

For each Flu dose, a gene's call against YPD is "up" or "down" if it passes the
DE cutoff in that direction against both YPD replicates, "none" if it passes
against neither, and "partial" otherwise. A gene is specific to one dose if it is
up (or down) at that dose and "none" at the other; "both doses" is the same set
as the YPD vs Fluconazole consensus genes.

`log2FC_16_vs_8` / `padj_16_vs_8` come from the direct Flu.2 vs Flu.1 comparison;
`supported_16_vs_8` is TRUE when that comparison is significant in the expected
direction. Each dose is a single 10x run, so a dose-specific gene may reflect
dose, batch, or both.

```{r dose_specific}
dose_calls <- de_all %>%
  filter(condition_pair == "YPD vs Fluconazole") %>%
  left_join(de_comparisons %>% select(comparison, test), by = "comparison") %>%
  mutate(dose = recode(test, Flu.1 = "16", Flu.2 = "8"),
         call = case_when(padj < PADJ_CUT & log2FoldChange >  LFC_CUT ~ "up",
                          padj < PADJ_CUT & log2FoldChange < -LFC_CUT ~ "down",
                          TRUE ~ "none")) %>%
  group_by(gene, gene_name, dose) %>%
  summarise(call = case_when(n() < 2           ~ NA_character_,   # not tested vs both YPD replicates
                             all(call == "up")   ~ "up",
                             all(call == "down") ~ "down",
                             all(call == "none") ~ "none",
                             TRUE                ~ "partial"),
            mean_log2FC = mean(log2FoldChange),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dose, values_from = c(call, mean_log2FC))

direct_16_vs_8 <- de_all %>%
  filter(comparison == "Flu.2 vs Flu.1") %>%
  select(gene, log2FC_16_vs_8 = log2FoldChange, padj_16_vs_8 = padj)

dose_specific <- dose_calls %>%
  mutate(dose_class = case_when(
    call_16 %in% c("up", "down") & call_8 == "none"  ~ paste(call_16, "in Flu at 16 ug/ml only"),
    call_8  %in% c("up", "down") & call_16 == "none" ~ paste(call_8,  "in Flu at 8 ug/ml only"),
    call_16 %in% c("up", "down") & call_16 == call_8 ~ paste(call_16, "in Flu at both doses"),
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dose_class)) %>%
  left_join(direct_16_vs_8, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(expected_sign = case_when(
           dose_class == "up in Flu at 16 ug/ml only"   ~  1,
           dose_class == "down in Flu at 16 ug/ml only" ~ -1,
           dose_class == "up in Flu at 8 ug/ml only"    ~ -1,
           dose_class == "down in Flu at 8 ug/ml only"  ~  1),
         supported_16_vs_8 = !is.na(expected_sign) & !is.na(padj_16_vs_8) &
           padj_16_vs_8 < PADJ_CUT & sign(log2FC_16_vs_8) == expected_sign) %>%
  select(-expected_sign) %>%
  arrange(dose_class, desc(abs(coalesce(mean_log2FC_16, 0) - coalesce(mean_log2FC_8, 0))))

knitr::kable(dose_specific %>%
               group_by(dose_class) %>%
               summarise(n_genes = n(), n_supported_16_vs_8 = sum(supported_16_vs_8), .groups = "drop"),
             caption = "YPD vs Fluconazole genes by dose (up/down = in Flu relative to YPD)")

for (cl in grep("only", unique(dose_specific$dose_class), value = TRUE)) {
  print(knitr::kable(dose_specific %>% filter(dose_class == cl) %>% head(15) %>%
                       select(gene, gene_name, mean_log2FC_16, mean_log2FC_8,
                              log2FC_16_vs_8, padj_16_vs_8, supported_16_vs_8),
                     digits = 3, caption = paste("Top genes:", cl)))
}

write.csv(dose_specific, file.path(OUT_DIR, "DE_YPD_vs_Flu_dose_specific_genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Ergosterol enrichment in fluconazole

Fluconazole inhibits Erg11; cells respond by inducing the ergosterol pathway
(via Upc2/Ecm22). Two one-sided tests per YPD vs Flu comparison, on genes DESeq2
tested (non-NA padj):

- Fisher's exact test: are ergosterol genes over-represented among the genes up
  in Flu (padj < 0.05, log2FC > 1)?
- Wilcoxon rank-sum test: are ergosterol genes' log2FC higher than other genes'?
  Uses every ergosterol gene, so it detects a moderate pathway-wide induction.

Two further comparisons use a two-sided Wilcoxon:

- YPD.1 vs YPD.2 (replicate control): ergosterol genes should not differ between
  replicates; "up" means higher in YPD.2.
- Flu.2 vs Flu.1 (dose comparison): "up" means higher at 16 than at 8 ug/ml. A
  stronger ergosterol induction at the higher dose is expected, but each dose is a
  single 10x run, so a difference here could also be batch.

```{r ergosterol_enrichment}
erg_test <- function(d, alternative) {
  is_erg <- d$gene %in% erg_orfs
  is_up  <- d$padj < PADJ_CUT & d$log2FoldChange > LFC_CUT
  ft <- fisher.test(table(factor(is_erg, c(TRUE, FALSE)), factor(is_up, c(TRUE, FALSE))),
                    alternative = "greater")
  wt <- wilcox.test(d$log2FoldChange[is_erg], d$log2FoldChange[!is_erg],
                    alternative = alternative)
  tibble(n_tested         = nrow(d),
         n_up_in_test     = sum(is_up),
         n_erg_tested     = sum(is_erg),
         n_erg_up_in_test = sum(is_erg & is_up),
         pct_erg_up       = 100 * mean(is_up[is_erg]),
         pct_other_up     = 100 * mean(is_up[!is_erg]),
         fisher_OR        = unname(ft$estimate),
         fisher_p         = ft$p.value,
         median_lfc_erg   = median(d$log2FoldChange[is_erg]),
         median_lfc_other = median(d$log2FoldChange[!is_erg]),
         wilcox_p         = wt$p.value)
}

flu_cmp  <- de_comparisons$comparison[de_comparisons$condition_pair == "YPD vs Fluconazole"]
ctrl_cmp <- c("Flu.2 vs Flu.1", "YPD.1 vs YPD.2")   # dose comparison, replicate control

erg_enrich <- bind_rows(
  de_all %>% filter(comparison %in% flu_cmp, !is.na(padj)) %>%
    group_by(comparison) %>% group_modify(~ erg_test(.x, "greater")) %>% ungroup(),
  de_all %>% filter(comparison %in% ctrl_cmp, !is.na(padj)) %>%
    group_by(comparison) %>% group_modify(~ erg_test(.x, "two.sided")) %>% ungroup()
)

knitr::kable(erg_enrich %>% mutate(across(c(fisher_p, wilcox_p), ~ format(.x, digits = 2))),
             digits = 3, caption = "Ergosterol genes among genes up in the test dataset")
write.csv(erg_enrich, file.path(OUT_DIR, "DE_ergosterol_enrichment_Flu.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r ergosterol_plots, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 8}

erg_lfc <- de_all %>%

         sig = ifelse(!is.na(padj) & padj < PADJ_CUT & abs(log2FoldChange) > LFC_CUT, "*", ""))

gene_order <- erg_lfc %>% filter(comparison %in% flu_cmp) %>%

       caption = "W = Wilcoxon p (ergosterol vs other genes); F = Fisher p (DE up in test)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
```

# GO enrichment of consensus genes

Unbiased check: GO biological-process enrichment of the consensus genes in each
direction for each condition pair (background: genes tested in that condition
pair). For YPD vs Fluconazole (genes responding at both doses), sterol terms
should come up without being chosen.

```{r consensus_go, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 11}
run_go <- function(genes, universe, label) {
  if (length(genes) < 5) {
    cat(label, ": fewer than 5 genes, skipped\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  ego <- enrichGO(genes, OrgDb = org.Sc.sgd.db, keyType = "ORF", ont = "BP",
                  universe = universe, pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                  minGSSize = 5, maxGSSize = 500)
  if (is.null(ego) || nrow(as.data.frame(ego)) == 0) {
    cat(label, ": no enriched GO terms\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  as.data.frame(ego) %>% mutate(gene_list = label)
}

go_lists <- consensus %>%
  mutate(list = paste0(condition_pair, ": ", direction)) %>%
  split(.$list)

consensus_go <- bind_rows(imap(go_lists, function(d, label) {
  universe <- unique(de_all$gene[de_all$condition_pair == d$condition_pair[1] & !is.na(de_all$padj)])
  run_go(d$gene, universe, label)
}))

if (nrow(consensus_go) > 0) {
  consensus_go <- consensus_go %>%
    mutate(sterol_term = grepl("sterol|steroid", Description, ignore.case = TRUE))

  knitr::kable(consensus_go %>% group_by(gene_list) %>%
                 slice_min(p.adjust, n = 8, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
                 select(gene_list, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio, p.adjust),
               digits = 4, caption = "Top GO BP terms per consensus gene list")

  p_go <- consensus_go %>%
    group_by(gene_list) %>% slice_min(p.adjust, n = 8, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Description = str_trunc(Description, 50)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(-log10(p.adjust), reorder(Description, -log10(p.adjust)),
               size = Count, color = sterol_term)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#E15759", "FALSE" = "#4E79A7"),
                       labels = c("TRUE" = "sterol / steroid", "FALSE" = "other")) +
    facet_wrap(~ gene_list, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    labs(x = "-log10 padj", y = NULL, size = "Genes", color = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8), strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
  print(p_go)

  ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "DE_GO_consensus_genes.pdf"), p_go, width = 13, height = 11, units = "in")
  write.csv(consensus_go, file.path(OUT_DIR, "DE_GO_consensus_genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

# Galactose

Galactose (scgal.1) against YPD (both replicates), against each fluconazole
dose and against sc2glu.2. log2FC = galactose / ref, so positive = higher in
galactose. sc2glu.2 vs Galactose is the cleanest carbon-source contrast (same
synthetic complete medium, glucose vs galactose). Galactose has a single run, so
every comparison here is condition + batch, and its "consensus" genes are
reproducible across the reference datasets, not across galactose replicates.

These comparisons use the strains shared by all six datasets including scgal.1,
fewer than the original comparisons; compare DE gene counts with that in mind
(`n_strains` in the table).

As a positive control, genes annotated to GO:0006012 "galactose metabolic
process" (GAL1, GAL7, GAL10, ...) should be strongly up in galactose against
every glucose-grown reference.

```{r gal_de}
de_comparisons_gal <- bind_rows(
  crossing(ref = c("YPD.1", "YPD.2"), test = "scgal.1"),
  crossing(ref = c("Flu.1", "Flu.2"), test = "scgal.1"),
  tibble(ref = "sc2glu.2", test = "scgal.1")
) %>%
  annotate_comparisons()

knitr::kable(de_comparisons_gal %>% select(comparison, flu_doses, condition_pair, type))

de_res_gal <- map2(de_comparisons_gal$ref, de_comparisons_gal$test, run_de)
names(de_res_gal) <- de_comparisons_gal$comparison

# Original + galactose comparisons together
cmp_all_gal <- bind_rows(de_comparisons, de_comparisons_gal)

de_all_gal <- bind_rows(c(de_res, de_res_gal)) %>%
  left_join(cmp_all_gal %>% select(comparison, condition_pair, type), by = "comparison") %>%
  mutate(comparison = factor(comparison, levels = cmp_all_gal$comparison))

gene_names_gal <- setNames(gene_label(unique(de_all_gal$gene)), unique(de_all_gal$gene))
de_all_gal <- de_all_gal %>% mutate(gene_name = gene_names_gal[gene], .after = gene)

de_summary_gal <- de_all_gal %>%
  group_by(comparison, condition_pair, type) %>%
  summarise(n_strains      = first(n_strains),
            n_genes_tested = sum(!is.na(padj)),
            n_up_in_test   = sum(padj < PADJ_CUT & log2FoldChange >  LFC_CUT, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_up_in_ref    = sum(padj < PADJ_CUT & log2FoldChange < -LFC_CUT, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_DE_total     = n_up_in_test + n_up_in_ref,
            .groups = "drop")
knitr::kable(de_summary_gal,
             caption = "DE genes per comparison, with galactose (padj < 0.05, |log2FC| > 1); log2FC = test / ref")

for (nm in names(de_res_gal)) {
  write.csv(de_all_gal %>% filter(comparison == nm) %>% arrange(padj),
            file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0("DE_", gsub(" ", "_", nm), ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}
write.csv(de_summary_gal, file.path(OUT_DIR, "DE_summary_with_galactose.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Galactose metabolism gene set (positive control)
gal_set <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Sc.sgd.db, keys = "GO:0006012", keytype = "GOALL",
                                 columns = c("ORF", "GENENAME")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ORF)) %>%
  distinct(orf = ORF, gene_name = GENENAME) %>%
  mutate(gene_name = coalesce(gene_name, orf)) %>%
  arrange(gene_name)
gal_orfs <- gal_set$orf
cat("Galactose metabolism genes (GO:0006012):", nrow(gal_set), "\n")
```

## Consensus genes, galactose pairs

Same rule as above: DE in the same direction in every comparison of the pair
(YPD vs Galactose: 2, Fluconazole vs Galactose: 2, sc2glu vs Galactose: 1, so
for sc2glu this is simply the DE genes of sc2glu.2 vs scgal.1).

```{r gal_consensus, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 11}
gal_pairs <- unique(de_comparisons_gal$condition_pair)

n_cmp_per_pair_gal <- de_comparisons_gal %>% count(condition_pair, name = "n_expected")

consensus_gal <- de_all_gal %>%
  filter(condition_pair %in% gal_pairs) %>%
  group_by(condition_pair, gene, gene_name) %>%
  summarise(n_comparisons = n(),
            n_up   = sum(padj < PADJ_CUT & log2FoldChange >  LFC_CUT, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_down = sum(padj < PADJ_CUT & log2FoldChange < -LFC_CUT, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_log2FC = mean(log2FoldChange),
            min_abs_log2FC = min(abs(log2FoldChange)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(n_cmp_per_pair_gal, by = "condition_pair") %>%
  filter(n_comparisons == n_expected, n_up == n_expected | n_down == n_expected) %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(n_up == n_expected,
                            paste("up in", str_remove(condition_pair, "^.* vs ")),
                            paste("up in", str_remove(condition_pair, " vs .*$")))) %>%
  arrange(condition_pair, desc(abs(mean_log2FC)))

knitr::kable(consensus_gal %>% count(condition_pair, direction),
             caption = "Consensus DE genes, galactose pairs")

for (cp in unique(consensus_gal$condition_pair)) {
  print(knitr::kable(consensus_gal %>% filter(condition_pair == cp) %>% head(20) %>%
                       select(gene, gene_name, direction, mean_log2FC, min_abs_log2FC),
                     digits = 2, caption = paste("Top consensus genes:", cp)))
}

write.csv(consensus_gal, file.path(OUT_DIR, "DE_consensus_genes_galactose_pairs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  universe <- unique(de_all_gal$gene[de_all_gal$condition_pair == d$condition_pair[1] &

  run_go(d$gene, universe, label)
}))
```
